commands.name: git init
commands.description: Create an empty Git repository or reinitialize an existing one

commands.name: git clone
commands.description: Clone a repository into a new directory

commands.name: git add
commands.description: Add file contents to the index (staging area)

commands.name: git status
commands.description: Show the working tree status

commands.name: git commit
commands.description: Record changes to the repository
examples: git commit -am "fix: resolve crash on startup"

commands.name: git diff
commands.description: Show changes between commits, commit and working tree, etc.

commands.name: git reset
commands.description: Reset current HEAD to the specified state

commands.name: git rm
commands.description: Remove files from the working tree and from the index

commands.name: git mv
commands.description: Move or rename a file, a directory, or a symlink

commands.name: git restore
commands.description: Restore working tree files or staged files

commands.name: git branch
commands.description: List, create, or delete branches

commands.name: git checkout
commands.description: Switch branches or restore working tree files

commands.name: git switch
commands.description: Switch branches

commands.name: git merge
commands.description: Join two or more development histories together

commands.name: git rebase
commands.description: Reapply commits on top of another base tip

commands.name: git tag
commands.description: Create, list, delete or verify a tag object signed with GPG

commands.name: git fetch
commands.description: Download objects and refs from another repository

commands.name: git pull
commands.description: Fetch from and integrate with another repository or a local branch

commands.name: git push
commands.description: Update remote refs along with associated objects

commands.name: git remote
commands.description: Manage set of tracked repositories

commands.name: git log
commands.description: Show commit logs

commands.name: git show
commands.description: Show various types of objects (commits, tags, etc.)

commands.name: git stash
commands.description: Stash the changes in a dirty working directory away

commands.name: git cherry-pick
commands.description: Apply the changes introduced by some existing commits

commands.name: git revert
commands.description: Revert some existing commits by creating a new commit

commands.name: git bisect
commands.description: Use binary search to find the commit that introduced a bug

commands.name: git blame
commands.description: Show what revision and author last modified each line of a file

commands.name: git reflog
commands.description: Manage reflog information

commands.name: git config
commands.description: Get and set repository or global options

commands.name: git help
commands.description: Display help information about Git

commands.name: git clean
commands.description: Remove untracked files from the working tree

commands.name: git worktree
commands.description: Manage multiple working trees attached to the same repository

commands.name: git archive
commands.description: Create an archive of files from a named tree

commands.name: git bundle
commands.description: Move objects and references by archive

commands.name: git format-patch
commands.description: Prepare patches for e-mail submission

commands.name: git apply
commands.description: Apply a patch to files and/or to the index

commands.name: git am
commands.description: Apply a series of patches from a mailbox

commands.name: git submodule
commands.description: Initialize, update or inspect submodules

commands.name: git gc
commands.description: Cleanup unnecessary files and optimize the local repository

commands.name: git fsck
commands.description: Verifies the connectivity and validity of the objects in the database

commands.name: git describe
commands.description: Give an object a human readable name based on an available ref

commands.name: git notes
commands.description: Add or inspect object notes

commands.name: git range-diff
commands.description: Compare two commit ranges (e.g. two versions of a branch)

commands.name: git maintenance
commands.description: Run tasks to optimize Git repository data
